items.title: Dell Stock Shrugged Off the Nvidia Shipment Pause Reports and Jumped 6.7%
items.summary: Nvidia reportedly told Dell to hold shipments to four Asian countries, yet investors piled in anyway. One price level on Monday will reveal whether the market sees a brief hiccup or a lasting break in the AI buildout.

items.title: Sandisk Is Still Up 188% in 2026, 71% Below Its June High. Is a Flash Bust Priced In?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSandisk stock is up 188% in 2026 but 71% below its June high, and Micron fell on the same fears about memory prices. Sales kept setting records, but price gains have cooled, and TrendForce expects NAND contract prices to start falling in early 2027.

items.title: Dell Soars 14% in a Week, Nvidia Up 20%, as Jensen Huang Returns. Dell’s Record Quarter Wasn’t Why
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell shares rose 14% in a week, mostly in Monday’s AI hardware rally after Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as CEO. Dell’s record third quarter came after the rally, and a margin warning from Hewlett Packard Enterprise took back part of the gain.

items.title: “Demand Is Higher Than Supply”: AMD Just Dropped 24% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD stock is down 24% in the month through Nov. 27 as an AI chip selloff hit Nvidia, Intel and Dell even harder, weeks after AMD’s record third quarter.

items.title: Plot Twist: Nvidia’s Vera Rubin Gets 2-6.5x GB300’s Tokens per Dollar. Amazon’s Trainium Edge Was Against the Old Chip
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSemiAnalysis found that Nvidia’s Vera Rubin NVL72 rack delivers 2x to 6. 5x the tokens per dollar of total cost of its GB300 NVL72 rack.

items.title: Why DELL Stock Is Rising Today — and Why Analysts Still See 70%+ Upside
items.summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock is rising in premarket trading on Friday. After sharp swings earlier this week, the stock has found support as investors focus on the company’s strong fiscal Q3 results and higher full-year outlook. Wall Street has a Moderate Buy consensus rating on DELL stock, with an average 12-month price target of $511.10. This suggests 72.05% upside from current levels. items.title: Don't have time to shop Black Friday? AI will do it for you
items.summary: AI is everywhere, and now it's even jumping into the holiday shopping season, with Meta's Muse set to take over Black Friday shopping for many consumers. On this episode of Market Hang, Wall Street veteran Turney Duff discusses the latest trend with FAS Wealth Partners Chief Investment Strategist Mike Rode; Founder, ETFs Partner, and Portfolio Manager Michael Monaghan; Tema ETFs Head of Investment Strategy Paisley Nardini; and 22V Research President Dennis DeBusschere.

items.title: Dell Stocks Jump 5.28% as $132.3 Billion AI Backlog Keeps Buyers Coming
items.summary: Revenue doubled to $54.9 billion last quarter, and Dell lifted its fiscal 2027 outlook to $202 billion alongside a new $25 billion buyback.
